{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance'' support abilities}}
[[File:FFTA Support Ability Icon.png|right]]
'''Support abilities''' {{j|サポートアビリティ|Sapōto Abiriti}} in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' are learned via equipment. Each unit can only have one support ability "equipped" at a time, but can master other support abilities for later use. Support abilities are learned by equipping a [[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance weapons|weapon]] or [[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance armor|armor]].
